pageTitle: Lesson 13 · Getting Ready to Be a Guest
eyebrow: Lesson 13 · B1 · Being a Good Guest · 20 câu
heading: Getting Ready to Be a Guest
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Being a Good Guest – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 4–7.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Being a Good Guest (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Imagine finding an {invitation|invitation} in your letterbox: you have been invited to a party! What should you do first? Read the day and time carefully and check your calendar. If you are free, {reply|reply} as soon as you can so that your friend knows you will be there. Never just turn up without answering.

paras.label: B
paras.text: Being a guest means going to someone's party or simply visiting their home. It sounds like fun, and it usually is. But are you going to be a good guest? Good manners are the key. They show your {host|host}, the person who invited you, that you are really pleased to be there.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Before a party, ask if you can bring something. Perhaps your friend needs a ball for a game, or maybe you could bring a pizza to {pass around|pass around}. Many guests also bring a small present to say thank you; flowers or chocolates make perfect {host gifts|host gifts}.

paras.label: D
paras.text: Being on time matters too. If you arrive late, you may {hold everyone up|hold everyone up} and {spoil|spoil} the fun for the other guests. If possible, ask whether you can come a little early to help {set up|set up}.

paras.label: E
paras.text: There are plenty of jobs for early helpers. You could {fan|fan} out the napkins on the table, put out the funny party hats or make tiny sandwiches. Your host will {appreciate|appreciate} your help, and the party will be ready in no time.

parts.title: Part 1 · Matching headings
parts.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp cho mỗi đoạn. Mỗi tiêu đề dùng một lần.

items.label: Paragraph A
items.why: Đoạn A: đọc thiệp mời, xem lịch và **reply**.

items.label: Paragraph B
items.why: Đoạn B giải thích thế nào là khách và vì sao cần phép lịch sự.

items.label: Paragraph C
items.why: Đoạn C: mang bóng, pizza, hoa hoặc sô-cô-la.

items.label: Paragraph D
items.why: Đoạn D: đến muộn sẽ *hold everyone up*.

items.label: Paragraph E
items.why: Đoạn E liệt kê việc có thể làm khi đến sớm.

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: What should you do first when you receive an invitation?
options: Check the day, the time and your calendar.
Buy a present for the host.
questions.why: *Read the day and time carefully and check your calendar.*

questions.q: The writer says it is fine to go to a party without replying to the invitation.
questions.why: Sai. *Never just turn up without answering.*

questions.q: According to (B), what do good manners show your host?
options: that you are happy to be their guest
that you are richer than the other guests
that you want to leave early
that you are a good cook
questions.why: *…that you are really pleased to be there.*

questions.q: Which of these does the writer mention as a good present for a host?
questions.why: *flowers or chocolates make perfect host gifts.* Pizza và bóng là đồ mang đến cho bữa tiệc, không phải quà.

questions.q: According to (D), arriving late can affect the other guests.
questions.why: Đúng. *you may hold everyone up and spoil the fun for the other guests.*

questions.q: Why might a host be glad if a guest arrives a little early?
options: The guest can help get things ready.
The guest can eat more food.
The host can go out for a while.
questions.why: *ask whether you can come a little early to help set up.*

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: Which paragraph does this picture match best?
questions.why: Cậu bé vừa lấy thư mời ở hộp thư → đoạn A.
questions.alt: A smiling boy runs away from a letterbox holding a letter, while a small dog jumps beside him

questions.q: According to the text, what should the boy do next?
options: Check the date and reply to the invitation.
Go straight to the party without telling anyone.
questions.why: Đoạn A: xem ngày giờ rồi **reply**.
questions.alt: A smiling boy runs away from a letterbox holding a letter, while a small dog jumps beside him

questions.q: What are the children in this picture doing?
options: helping to set up before a party
questions.why: Bày mũ giấy, bỏng ngô lên bàn → giúp chuẩn bị (đoạn E).
questions.alt: A boy and a girl prepare a party table with paper hats; the girl holds a bowl of popcorn and says: I will put out the popcorn.

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: Last month my friend Leo invited me to his birthday party. [1] On the day, I arrived half an hour early. [2] When the other guests came, everything was ready. [3]
options: Leo was cross because I had arrived so late.
I replied the same evening to say I would come.
Leo's mum gave me a job: putting the party hats on the table.
Nobody was there because the party had already finished.
Leo's mum said I was the most helpful guest she had ever had.

items.why: Nhận lời mời → trả lời ngay (đúng như đoạn A).
Đến sớm → được giao việc chuẩn bị.
Mọi thứ sẵn sàng → mẹ Leo khen. Đây là câu kết hợp lý.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *…you may hold everyone up* (D). To **hold someone up** means to…
questions.why: **Hold sb up** = làm ai chậm trễ.

questions.q: *…a pizza to pass around* (C). If you **pass** food **around**, you…
options: offer it to each person in turn

questions.q: *Your host will appreciate your help* (E). **Appreciate** means…
